parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: The packet filter direction field is used to indicate for what traffic direction the filter applies. See {{bibref|3GPP-TS.24.501|Clause 9.11.4.13}} {{enum}}

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Packet filter component type identifier. See {{bibref|3GPP-TS.24.501|Clause 9.11.4.13}}.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Matching value for the component type. See {{bibref|3GPP-TS.24.501|Clause 9.11.4.13}}.

object.description: This object describes the PDU QoS Rule Filter table. As each packet filter is logically anded with the others, there shall not be more than one occurrence of each packet filter component type.
